expected_finding: Celecoxib contains a sulfonamide moiety and is contraindicated in patients with sulfonamide allergy.
Co-administration causes severe synergistic vasodilation and life-threatening hypotension.
Spironolactone is contraindicated in severe renal impairment due to high risk of hyperkalemia.
NSAIDs may decrease the antihypertensive effect of ACE inhibitors and decrease renal function.
Ambiguity/Duplication: Active orders exist for both brand and generic variations.
